narrative: Deeper continuation of round 13's bp35 L9 mapping within the same session. Two key refinements: (1) DEATH-SCREEN CLARIFICATION -- re-tested the round-13 death with a much simpler action sequence (2 pure RIGHT moves from true start, no switch/left detour) and got the IDENTICAL death-frame content (same exact bounding boxes for the 3rd switch, doors, and pillar rows found in round 13), proving that frame is a fixed generic game-over overview shown regardless of the death location, not a per-death reveal of nearby hazards. This means the round-13 'hidden 3rd switch + 3 doors + 2 pillar rows' ARE real level content (visible on a full overview) but their live-camera coordinates and reachability are still unknown -- do not assume they are physically adjacent to where any given death occurred. (2) HAZARD ZONE NARROWED + SAFE BYPASS FOUND -- confirmed via a clean, switch-free test that a pure DOWN-gravity rightward walk dies on the SECOND right slide from true start (first slide reaches cols26-27 safely, second is lethal), independent of any switch-clicking history (rules out the switches as a confound). By contrast, sliding RIGHT while in UP-gravity is completely safe across the same horizontal span, reaching the room's right wall at cols56-57 after 6 slides with nothing new discovered along the way (no additional switches, doors, or toggles visible). Flipping gravity back DOWN from that far-right position (using the 2nd/last start-room switch) lands the player safely in the DOWN-gravity floor room at cols56-58 -- bypassing the lethal middle zone entirely. From there, one further LEFT is safe (lands at cols51-52) but a second LEFT back toward the middle is lethal again -- narrowing the hazardous span of the down-gravity floor to approximately cols 28-51 (approached from either side, entry into that range from outside it is fatal; the true left/right boundary was not pinned to single-column precision). No switch, door, or toggle was found visible anywhere along the safely-reachable cols51-58 stretch, so this bypass route currently leads nowhere new -- both start-room switches are consumed reaching it, and the level's 3rd switch (from the death overview) has still not been physically located or reached during live play. No new level banked; frontier stays at level 8.
novel_mechanics_found: The GAME_OVER frame renders a FIXED, deterministic overview (same object bounding boxes every time) regardless of where in the level the death occurred -- confirmed by reproducing the identical death-frame content from two structurally different death sequences. Treat it as a level-overview reference, not a location-specific hazard reveal.

The down-gravity floor room (rows37-41) has a lethal invisible hazard occupying roughly cols 28-51; entry from either the left (col27->28+) or the right (col52->51-) side is fatal, but the two ends (cols<=27 and cols>=51) are each independently safe.

The up-gravity room (rows27-31) is fully safe across its entire width (left wall ~col15 to right wall ~col57), with no hazards found there -- gravity direction changes which of the two parallel corridors is safe to traverse at a given horizontal position.
dead_ends: Both DOWN-gravity approaches into the cols28-51 span (from col27 going right, and from col52 going left) are lethal. Do not re-test this exact span without first finding a way to detect/avoid the specific hazard cell(s) within it.

The up-gravity-right-then-down-flip bypass reaches cols51-58 safely but that stretch has no discovered interactive objects (no switch, door, or toggle) -- currently a dead end on its own, though it may connect to something not yet explored (e.g. moving further within the down-gravity room from col51/58 in ways not yet tried, or the 3rd switch/doors being reachable only via a different room transition entirely).
